component.name: Runefin
component.summary: A Jellyfin client drawn entirely by Rune

description.p: Runefin browses a Jellyfin server and plays video in the same window, with no web view and no second render stack.
It has a desktop layout and a Big Screen layout for a TV: a 1280x720 design height, full-screen launch, a 64 pt safe gutter and native gamepad navigation.
The in-app player supports direct play and transcoding, text and bitmap subtitles, chapters, a queue and playback reporting.
